name: pi-squeeze
description: Shrinks bash output before it reaches the agent's context: native compactors for git, search, listings, tests, builds (cargo, gradle, Maven, javac, Xcode, tsc, docker), Android (adb, lint, detekt), linters, package installs and logs, plus rtk when install
